leadText: Yumiko Kobayashi (Japanese: 小林由美子 Kobayashi Yumiko) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Yumiko Kobayashi (Japanese: 小林由美子 Kobayashi Yumiko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kobayashi was born on June 18, 1979, in (now ), , . As an adult, she became a voice actress and was initially affiliated with the talent agency , but she started freelancing in August 2007. Kobayashi occasionally lent her voice to the during and . During , she landed her best-known role in the animated series, which was Nimbasa City Gym Leader Elesa. She is married and has two children.

==Trivia==
Kobayashi is a member of the voice actress quartet "Prits". Two of its other members, Natsuko Kuwatani and Nana Mizuki, have also voiced characters for .
